Personalized Comfort Experience

Overview of Golden Technologies Advanced Power Recliners

Golden technologies sets the standard for quality, craftsmanship and innovation. Discover the comfort you deserve offered in a variety of styles, colors and sizes back by lifetime warranties.

Featured Power Lift Recliners

Two lift recliners that anchor a showroom.

Lead premium with the Cloud Supreme; win the value shopper with the Comforter.

Flagship power lift recliner

The Cloud™ Supreme — PR519

A contoured memory-foam chaise pad paired with a 5-Zone positioning system for deeply personalized, lasting comfort.

  • 5 Comfort Zones — footrest, backrest, headrest, and lumbar move independently.
  • Patented Twilight™ Tilt + MaxiComfort® positioning via AutoDrive™ control.
  • Rejuvenate position reduces lower-body pressure by 22%.
  • Butler tray table and LED reading light included; Nirvana™ massage + HeatWave™ optional.
  • Two sizes with gel-infused chaise pad; Class II medical device.
View product →
America's favorite lift chair for 20+ years

The Comforter — PR531

Inclusive small-to-tall sizing and approachable comfort — the value anchor that fits nearly every customer.

  • “Small to Tall, we build them all” — Petite/Small through Tall and wide sizes.
  • Up to 500 lb capacity on Comforter Wide; convenient 1-Zone lift & recline.
  • Straight & Mid Lift standard, with plush chenille fabrics.
  • Optional Deluxe Therapeutic Heat & Vibrating Massage.
View product →

Featured Mobility

Travel-ready mobility that drives retail traffic.

A heavy-duty folding scooter and Golden's most capable folding power chair.

Heavy-duty folding travel scooter

Buzzaround® CarryOn HD — GB220

A travel-ready folding scooter that goes the distance and stores easily — heavy-duty capacity in an airline-friendly package.

  • 400 lb capacity with a full-size padded seat and 8.25" drive wheels.
  • Up to 22-mile range (12.5Ah + free 6.5Ah EverRun™ lithium battery).
  • Folds to 14" with 4-point carry handles; airline- and cruise-friendly.
  • Front/rear LED lights, USB port, drink and cane holders.
View product →
Most capable folding power chair

Golden Ally™ Pro — GP304

The most capable of Golden's app-enabled folding power wheelchairs — travel-ready portability with real everyday capability.

  • 330 lb capacity; up to 13-mile range; folds and stands on end.
  • App-enabled remote control and airline-friendly EverRun™ lithium battery.
  • Adjustable recline back, width armrests, and leg-length footplate.
  • Front suspension, omni-directional wheels, and USB A & C ports.
View product →

The Golden Difference

What your sales team can explain in one sentence.

Move the conversation from price to value, comfort, safety, and independence.

5-Zone Comfort Zones

Golden's patented Comfort Zones move the footrest, backrest, headrest, and lumbar independently for fully personalized positioning.

MaxiComfort® + Twilight™ Tilt

Patented positioning elevates the legs above the heart and unlocks the Rejuvenate position for pressure relief and circulation.

Rejuvenate Position

Shifts pressure from the seat to the back — a clinically demonstrated 22% reduction in lower-body pressure versus seated.

Nirvana™ + HeatWave™

Optional Swedish air massage and far-infrared heat turn a lift chair into a daily wellness experience — a strong upsell.

Small to Tall

Inclusive sizing across recliners and lift chairs, with heavy-duty capacities up to 600 lbs on select models.

American-made since 1985

A family-owned, third-generation U.S. manufacturer building Class II medical devices with intuitive AutoDrive™ controls.

Turn the lift chair conversation into a full mobility solution.

Customers usually start with one need: getting out of a chair safely, moving around the home, traveling with confidence, or recovering more comfortably. Golden gives your staff a complete product ladder to solve each of those needs under one trusted brand — so a single lead becomes a lift chair, then a scooter, a power chair, and an in-home bed solution.
